interpretation: The offline replay found lyric candidates for 99/100 songs. Seventeen public lyric pages were compared against selected text by normalized hash (17% source-observation coverage). Two mismatches (Blackbird and Iris) now have reproduced selected hashes and classified word-level differences; 15 remain to review. None currently establishes exact performance-level lyric gold, so the 0 adjudicated-correctness count is not a source-search result and does not mean the lyrics were rejected.

referenceEvaluation.interpretation: Seventeen traceable lyric pages have now been compared against selected text by normalized full-text hash (17% source-page coverage). Two mismatches (Blackbird and Iris) have reproduced selected hashes and classified word-level differences; 15 mismatches still need review. Classified mismatches are not automatically incorrect performance transcriptions. None of these pages is currently promoted as exact recording-level gold.

practicalLevels.countsAs: A traceable page for the matched song/artist was inspected; reports reference coverage only.
practicalLevels.doesNotClaim: That the selected text is correct.

practicalLevels.countsAs: At least two sources with distinct provenance agree on substantive lyric content after known version and transcription differences are classified.
The intended recording edition is bound and the selected words, repeats, and vocalized ending agree with an authorized recording-specific reference or a documented listening review.
practicalLevels.doesNotClaim: Exact digital master identity unless separately established.

referenceEvaluation.countingRule: Hash equality is a strong exact-match signal. Hash inequality triggers diff review; it is not automatically an incorrect result. A classified difference remains nonmatching until the intended lyric scope is adjudicated. Provider labels count as independent only when provenance is known to be distinct.

sourceContributions.method: SHA-256 source identity joins each discovered result to combineSources provenance. Candidate use is reported without raw candidate IDs or lyrics.
sourceContributions.interpretation: Candidate availability is distinct from actual use. Contribution counts are distinct songs. Agreement among provider labels is not proof of independent sourcing or correctness.

next: Complete the remaining 15 source-page diff reviews; for each, verify song/artist identity, source provenance, normalized sequence, and edition scope. Classify wording, repeats, and version differences before deciding whether the selected text is corroborated or incorrect for its intended scope.

lyrics.interpretation: Exact normalized lyric or chord-sequence hash agreement, including a shared hash within a conflicting group, is a consolidation signal, not proof of independent provenance or correctness.

chords.interpretation: Exact normalized lyric or chord-sequence hash agreement, including a shared hash within a conflicting group, is a consolidation signal, not proof of independent provenance or correctness.

crossProviderCandidateIdReuse.interpretation: Candidate-ID reuse across provider adapters is not enough to merge or count evidence as independent; compare field payload hashes and provider provenance.
crossProviderCandidateIdReuse.betterLyricsAdapterNote: BetterLyrics uses LRCLIB as its catalog and then resolves lyric content through the Better Lyrics API; a shared catalog ID does not guarantee identical lyric payloads.
